topic: Grace Groner: The $180 Investment That Ran for 75 Years

artifacts.angle: Uninterrupted compounding on an essential product removes the friction of taxes, timing errors, and emotional panic selling.
artifacts.hook: In 1935, a quiet clerk bought three shares of a healthcare company for $180, never touched them or added another penny, and died 75 years later with over $7 million.
artifacts.title: The $180 Investment That Outlasted a Lifetime
